right_panel_copy.title: New Outdoor Entry to University Station Skywalk
right_panel_copy.body: A welcoming new gateway to the University campus will address and overcome current issues of accessibility, safety, and comfort. This space will act as an intermediate for pedestrians entering the campus or visiting the amenities below.

right_panel_copy.title: Affordable Graduate Student Housing
right_panel_copy.body: A pair of 3-storey affordable student housing buildings will be geared towards graduate students. These buildings feature open, park-like courtyards and surrounding green spaces to provide easy access to footpaths and nurture the residents' mental well-being.

right_panel_copy.title: Sound, Visual & Safety Art Wall
right_panel_copy.body: A barrier constructed between residences and Crowchild Trail will increase safety and enhance the visual and acoustic environment. Following the tradition of rock painting, this wall will act as a mural to enhance vibrancy.
